review.readOnlyVisualReview: Central forks clearer, no evident new major mountain-crossing trunk. A small mountain-skirt bend northwest of Shanggu is retained.

limitations: Artwork-based mountain masks do not model real elevation or every green slope.
Some fixed castle approaches and mountain-pass roads remain; this revision reduces crossings rather than proving zero.
This is a map preview and its data; no playable ROM/build is changed.
